sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><description>LinkedIn Company Profile Widget — 3-tab portal card (Profile, Posts, About) using LinkedIn's official badge and follow-button SDKs.</description><name>LinkedIn Company Widget</name><id>linkedin-company-widget</id><template><div class="linkedin-widget-wrapper" ng-class="{'theme-dark': c.data.theme === 'dark'}">

  <!-- Header Bar -->
  <div class="lw-header">
    <div class="lw-header-logo">
      <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 34 34" class="lw-li-icon">
        <path d="M34,2.5v29A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,31.5,34H2.5A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,0,31.5V2.5A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,2.5,0h29A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,34,2.5ZM10,13H5V29h5Zm.45-5.5A2.88,2.88,0,1,0,7.59,10.37,2.86,2.86,0,0,0,10.45,7.5ZM29,19.28c0-4.81-3.06-6.68-6.1-6.68a5.7,5.7,0,0,0-5.06,2.58H17.77V13H13V29h5V20.49a3.32,3.32,0,0,1,3-3.58c1.96,0,3,1.26,3,3.52V29h5Z" fill="#fff"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <span class="lw-header-title">{{c.data.widget_title || 'LinkedIn'}}</span>
    <div class="lw-header-actions">
      <button class="lw-tab-btn" ng-class="{active: c.activeTab === 'profile'}" ng-click="c.setTab('profile')">Profile</button>
      <button class="lw-tab-btn" ng-class="{active: c.activeTab === 'posts'}" ng-click="c.setTab('posts')">Posts</button>
      <button class="lw-tab-btn" ng-class="{active: c.activeTab === 'about'}" ng-click="c.setTab('about')">About</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Tab: Profile (LinkedIn Badge + Follow) -->
  <div class="lw-tab-content" ng-show="c.activeTab === 'profile'">

    <!-- Banner -->
    <div class="lw-banner" ng-style="c.bannerStyle()">
      <div class="lw-banner-overlay"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Company Card -->
    <div class="lw-company-card">
      <div class="lw-logo-wrap">
        <img ng-if="c.data.logo_url" ng-src="{{c.data.logo_url}}" alt="{{c.data.company_name}} logo" class="lw-company-logo" />
        <div ng-if="!c.data.logo_url" class="lw-logo-placeholder">
          <span>{{c.data.company_name | limitTo:2 | uppercase}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="lw-company-info">
        <h2 class="lw-company-name">{{c.data.company_name}}</h2>
        <p class="lw-company-tagline">{{c.data.tagline}}</p>
        <p class="lw-company-meta">
          <span ng-if="c.data.industry"><i class="fa fa-building-o"></i> {{c.data.industry}}</span>
          <span ng-if="c.data.location"><i class="fa fa-map-marker"></i> {{c.data.location}}</span>
          <span ng-if="c.data.followers"><i class="fa fa-users"></i> {{c.data.followers | number}} followers</span>
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="lw-actions">
        <a class="lw-btn lw-btn-primary" ng-href="{{c.data.linkedin_url}}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 34 34" class="lw-btn-icon"><path d="M34,2.5v29A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,31.5,34H2.5A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,0,31.5V2.5A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,2.5,0h29A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,34,2.5ZM10,13H5V29h5Zm.45-5.5A2.88,2.88,0,1,0,7.59,10.37,2.86,2.86,0,0,0,10.45,7.5ZM29,19.28c0-4.81-3.06-6.68-6.1-6.68a5.7,5.7,0,0,0-5.06,2.58H17.77V13H13V29h5V20.49a3.32,3.32,0,0,1,3-3.58c1.96,0,3,1.26,3,3.52V29h5Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
          View on LinkedIn
        </a>
        <!-- LinkedIn Official Follow Button -->
        <div class="lw-follow-embed" ng-if="c.data.company_id">
          <script type="IN/FollowCompany" data-id="{{c.data.company_id}}" data-counter="bottom"></script>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Official LinkedIn Badge (rendered in iframe-like container) -->
    <div class="lw-badge-section" ng-if="c.data.vanity_name">
      <div class="lw-badge-label">Official Profile Badge</div>
      <div class="lw-badge-container">
        <div class="badge-base LI-profile-badge"
             data-locale="en_US"
             data-size="large"
             data-theme="{{c.data.theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light'}}"
             data-type="HORIZONTAL"
             data-vanity="{{c.data.vanity_name}}"
             data-version="v1">
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Tab: Posts (Curated links / feed placeholder) -->
  <div class="lw-tab-content" ng-show="c.activeTab === 'posts'">
    <div class="lw-posts-header">
      <span>Latest from {{c.data.company_name}}</span>
      <a ng-href="{{c.data.linkedin_url}}/posts/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="lw-see-all">See all posts <i class="fa fa-external-link"></i></a>
    </div>

    <!-- Post cards -->
    <div class="lw-post-card" ng-repeat="post in c.data.featured_posts track by $index">
      <div class="lw-post-meta">
        <img ng-if="c.data.logo_url" ng-src="{{c.data.logo_url}}" class="lw-post-avatar" />
        <div ng-if="!c.data.logo_url" class="lw-post-avatar-placeholder">{{c.data.company_name | limitTo:1}}</div>
        <div class="lw-post-author">
          <strong>{{c.data.company_name}}</strong>
          <span>{{post.date}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="lw-post-text">{{post.text}}</p>
      <a ng-if="post.url" ng-href="{{post.url}}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="lw-post-link">
        <i class="fa fa-linkedin-square"></i> View post
      </a>
    </div>

    <!-- Empty state -->
    <div class="lw-empty-state" ng-if="!c.data.featured_posts || c.data.featured_posts.length === 0">
      <i class="fa fa-newspaper-o fa-2x"></i>
      <p>Configure featured posts in widget options, or</p>
      <a ng-href="{{c.data.linkedin_url}}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="lw-btn lw-btn-outline">
        View posts on LinkedIn
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Tab: About -->
  <div class="lw-tab-content" ng-show="c.activeTab === 'about'">
    <div class="lw-about-grid">
      <div class="lw-about-card" ng-if="c.data.description">
        <div class="lw-about-card-icon"><i class="fa fa-info-circle"></i></div>
        <div class="lw-about-card-body">
          <h4>About</h4>
          <p>{{c.data.description}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="lw-about-card" ng-if="c.data.website">
        <div class="lw-about-card-icon"><i class="fa fa-globe"></i></div>
        <div class="lw-about-card-body">
          <h4>Website</h4>
          <a ng-href="{{c.data.website}}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{{c.data.website}}</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="lw-about-card" ng-if="c.data.industry">
        <div class="lw-about-card-icon"><i class="fa fa-building"></i></div>
        <div class="lw-about-card-body">
          <h4>Industry</h4>
          <p>{{c.data.industry}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="lw-about-card" ng-if="c.data.company_size">
        <div class="lw-about-card-icon"><i class="fa fa-users"></i></div>
        <div class="lw-about-card-body">
          <h4>Company size</h4>
          <p>{{c.data.company_size}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="lw-about-card" ng-if="c.data.headquarters">
        <div class="lw-about-card-icon"><i class="fa fa-map-marker"></i></div>
        <div class="lw-about-card-body">
          <h4>Headquarters</h4>
          <p>{{c.data.headquarters}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="lw-about-card" ng-if="c.data.founded">
        <div class="lw-about-card-icon"><i class="fa fa-calendar"></i></div>
        <div class="lw-about-card-body">
          <h4>Founded</h4>
          <p>{{c.data.founded}}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="lw-about-cta">
      <a ng-href="{{c.data.linkedin_url}}/about/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="lw-btn lw-btn-outline">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 34 34" class="lw-btn-icon"><path d="M34,2.5v29A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,31.5,34H2.5A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,0,31.5V2.5A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,2.5,0h29A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,34,2.5ZM10,13H5V29h5Zm.45-5.5A2.88,2.88,0,1,0,7.59,10.37,2.86,2.86,0,0,0,10.45,7.5ZM29,19.28c0-4.81-3.06-6.68-6.1-6.68a5.7,5.7,0,0,0-5.06,2.58H17.77V13H13V29h5V20.49a3.32,3.32,0,0,1,3-3.58c1.96,0,3,1.26,3,3.52V29h5Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
        Full profile on LinkedIn
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Footer -->
  <div class="lw-footer">
    <span>Powered by</span>
    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 34 34" class="lw-footer-icon"><path d="M34,2.5v29A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,31.5,34H2.5A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,0,31.5V2.5A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,2.5,0h29A2.5,2.5,0,0,1,34,2.5ZM10,13H5V29h5Zm.45-5.5A2.88,2.88,0,1,0,7.59,10.37,2.86,2.86,0,0,0,10.45,7.5ZM29,19.28c0-4.81-3.06-6.68-6.1-6.68a5.7,5.7,0,0,0-5.06,2.58H17.77V13H13V29h5V20.49a3.32,3.32,0,0,1,3-3.58c1.96,0,3,1.26,3,3.52V29h5Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
    <span>LinkedIn</span>
  </div>

</div>
</template><css>/* =============================================
   LinkedIn Company Widget — ServiceNow Portal
   ============================================= */

/* --- CSS Variables --- */
.linkedin-widget-wrapper {
  --li-blue: #0a66c2;
  --li-blue-dark: #004182;
  --li-blue-light: #e8f0fe;
  --li-black: #1b1f23;
  --li-gray: #86888a;
  --li-border: #e0e0e0;
  --li-bg: #ffffff;
  --li-card-bg: #ffffff;
  --li-text: #1b1f23;
  --li-text-muted: #6b7280;
  --li-radius: 12px;
  --li-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
  --li-transition: 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
  --li-header-height: 56px;

  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--li-text);
  background: var(--li-bg);
  border-radius: var(--li-radius);
  box-shadow: var(--li-shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
  max-width: 680px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
}

/* Dark theme */
.linkedin-widget-wrapper.theme-dark {
  --li-bg: #1b1f23;
  --li-card-bg: #23282e;
  --li-text: #e5e7eb;
  --li-text-muted: #9ca3af;
  --li-border: #374151;
  --li-blue-light: #1e3a5f;
  --li-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}

/* --- Header --- */
.lw-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--li-blue) 0%, var(--li-blue-dark) 100%);
  padding: 0 16px;
  height: var(--li-header-height);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10;
}

.lw-li-icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.lw-header-title {
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 15px;
  flex: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.lw-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
}

.lw-tab-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--li-transition), color var(--li-transition);
}

.lw-tab-btn:hover,
.lw-tab-btn.active {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  color: #fff;
}

.lw-tab-btn.active {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
}

/* --- Tab Content Transition --- */
.lw-tab-content {
  animation: lwFadeIn 0.28s ease;
  padding: 0;
}

@keyframes lwFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* --- Banner --- */
.lw-banner {
  width: 100%;
  height: 120px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a66c2 0%, #0e4d8f 50%, #083c72 100%);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.lw-banner::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0%, transparent 50%);
}

.lw-banner-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 40px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--li-bg), transparent);
}

/* --- Company Card --- */
.lw-company-card {
  padding: 0 20px 20px;
  position: relative;
  margin-top: -48px;
}

.lw-logo-wrap {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.lw-company-logo {
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 3px solid var(--li-bg);
  object-fit: contain;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  transition: transform var(--li-transition), box-shadow var(--li-transition);
}

.lw-company-logo:hover {
  transform: scale(1.04);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(10,102,194,0.3);
}

.lw-logo-placeholder {
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 3px solid var(--li-bg);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--li-blue), var(--li-blue-dark));
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.lw-company-name {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  color: var(--li-text);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.lw-company-tagline {
  color: var(--li-text-muted);
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.lw-company-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  color: var(--li-text-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}

.lw-company-meta span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}

.lw-company-meta .fa {
  color: var(--li-blue);
  font-size: 13px;
}

/* --- Action Buttons --- */
.lw-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.lw-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 9px 20px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--li-transition);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.lw-btn-primary {
  background: var(--li-blue);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--li-blue);
}

.lw-btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--li-blue-dark);
  border-color: var(--li-blue-dark);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(10,102,194,0.35);
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.lw-btn-outline {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--li-blue);
  border-color: var(--li-blue);
}

.lw-btn-outline:hover {
  background: var(--li-blue-light);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(10,102,194,0.15);
  color: var(--li-blue);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.lw-btn-icon {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* --- LinkedIn Official Badge Section --- */
.lw-badge-section {
  margin: 0 20px 20px;
  padding: 16px;
  background: var(--li-card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--li-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.lw-badge-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--li-text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.lw-badge-container {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
}

.lw-follow-embed {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

/* --- Posts Tab --- */
.lw-posts-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 16px 20px 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--li-text);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--li-border);
}

.lw-see-all {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--li-blue);
  text-decoration: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  transition: color var(--li-transition);
}

.lw-see-all:hover {
  color: var(--li-blue-dark);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.lw-post-card {
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--li-border);
  transition: background var(--li-transition);
}

.lw-post-card:hover {
  background: var(--li-blue-light);
}

.lw-post-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.lw-post-avatar {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  object-fit: contain;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--li-border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.lw-post-avatar-placeholder {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--li-blue), var(--li-blue-dark));
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.lw-post-author {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
}

.lw-post-author strong {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--li-text);
}

.lw-post-author span {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--li-text-muted);
}

.lw-post-text {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  color: var(--li-text);
  line-height: 1.55;
  font-size: 14px;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.lw-post-link {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--li-blue);
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 4px 0;
  transition: color var(--li-transition);
}

.lw-post-link:hover {
  color: var(--li-blue-dark);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* --- Empty State --- */
.lw-empty-state {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 48px 20px;
  color: var(--li-text-muted);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.lw-empty-state p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* --- About Tab --- */
.lw-about-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .lw-about-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.lw-about-card {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px;
  background: var(--li-card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--li-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: box-shadow var(--li-transition), transform var(--li-transition);
}

.lw-about-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(10,102,194,0.12);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.lw-about-card-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--li-blue-light);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;

</css><client_script>/**
 * LinkedIn Company Widget — Client-side Controller
 * ServiceNow Service Portal (AngularJS)
 */
api.controller = function($scope, $timeout) {
  var c = this;

  // Active tab state — default to 'profile'
  c.activeTab = 'profile';

  /**
   * Switch active tab and re-trigger LinkedIn SDK rendering
   * if switching to the profile tab (badge needs re-initialization).
   */
  c.setTab = function(tab) {
    c.activeTab = tab;
    if (tab === 'profile') {
      c.initLinkedInSDK();
    }
  };

  /**
   * Build a dynamic inline style for the banner background.
   * Falls back to a gradient if no custom banner image is configured.
   */
  c.bannerStyle = function() {
    if (c.data.banner_url) {
      return {
        'background-image': 'url(' + c.data.banner_url + ')',
        'background-size': 'cover',
        'background-position': 'center'
      };
    }
    // Default animated gradient banner using LinkedIn blue palette
    return {};
  };

  /**
   * Load (or reload) the LinkedIn platform SDK.
   * Required for:
   *   - IN/FollowCompany badge
   *   - LI-profile-badge (company profile card)
   * Safe to call multiple times — checks for existing instance first.
   */
  c.initLinkedInSDK = function() {
    $timeout(function() {
      // LinkedIn official badge script
      if (!document.getElementById('li-badge-script')) {
        var badgeScript = document.createElement('script');
        badgeScript.id = 'li-badge-script';
        badgeScript.src = 'https://platform.linkedin.com/badges/js/profile.js';
        badgeScript.async = true;
        badgeScript.defer = true;
        document.body.appendChild(badgeScript);
      } else if (window.LI && window.LI.init) {
        // Re-render badges if SDK already loaded
        window.LI.init();
      }

      // LinkedIn platform.js (follow button)
      if (!document.getElementById('li-platform-script') && c.data.company_id) {
        var platformScript = document.createElement('script');
        platformScript.id = 'li-platform-script';
        platformScript.src = 'https://platform.linkedin.com/in.js';
        platformScript.type = 'text/javascript';
        platformScript.innerHTML = 'lang: en_US';
        document.head.appendChild(platformScript);
      }
    }, 150);
  };

  // Initialize LinkedIn SDK on widget load
  c.initLinkedInSDK();
};
</client_script><script>/**
 * LinkedIn Company Widget — Server-side Script
 * ServiceNow Service Portal
 *
 * Merges widget instance options with system property defaults
 * and sends a clean data object to the client controller.
 */
(function() {

  /* ── Helper: read a sys_property with a fallback value ── */
  function sysProp(name, fallback) {
    var val = gs.getProperty(name, '');
    return val ? val : (fallback || '');
  }

  /* ── Widget instance options (set in the portal designer) ── */
  var opts = options || {};

  /* ── Build the data payload ── */
  data.widget_title   = opts.widget_title   || sysProp('linkedin.widget.title', 'Our LinkedIn');
  data.company_name   = opts.company_name   || sysProp('linkedin.widget.company_name', '');
  data.tagline        = opts.tagline        || sysProp('linkedin.widget.tagline', '');
  data.description    = opts.description    || sysProp('linkedin.widget.description', '');
  data.linkedin_url   = opts.linkedin_url   || sysProp('linkedin.widget.linkedin_url', 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/');
  data.vanity_name    = opts.vanity_name    || sysProp('linkedin.widget.vanity_name', '');
  data.company_id     = opts.company_id     || sysProp('linkedin.widget.company_id', '');
  data.logo_url       = opts.logo_url       || sysProp('linkedin.widget.logo_url', '');
  data.banner_url     = opts.banner_url     || sysProp('linkedin.widget.banner_url', '');
  data.website        = opts.website        || sysProp('linkedin.widget.website', '');
  data.industry       = opts.industry       || sysProp('linkedin.widget.industry', '');
  data.company_size   = opts.company_size   || sysProp('linkedin.widget.company_size', '');
  data.headquarters   = opts.headquarters   || sysProp('linkedin.widget.headquarters', '');
  data.location       = opts.location       || sysProp('linkedin.widget.location', '');
  data.founded        = opts.founded        || sysProp('linkedin.widget.founded', '');
  data.followers      = opts.followers      || sysProp('linkedin.widget.followers', '');
  data.theme          = opts.theme          || sysProp('linkedin.widget.theme', 'light');

  /*
   * Featured posts: JSON array stored in the widget option or sys_property.
   * Format: [{"text":"...", "date":"...", "url":"..."}, ...]
   *
   * Example sys_property value (linkedin.widget.featured_posts):
   * [{"text":"We are hiring!","date":"Mar 2026","url":"https://www.linkedin.com/posts/..."}]
   */
  var rawPosts = opts.featured_posts || sysProp('linkedin.widget.featured_posts', '');
  if (rawPosts) {
    try {
      data.featured_posts = JSON.parse(rawPosts);
    } catch (e) {
      gs.warn('LinkedIn Widget: could not parse featured_posts JSON — ' + e.message);
      data.featured_posts = [];
    }
  } else {
    data.featured_posts = [];
  }

})();
